provenance.note: The ClickHouse otel column names, and no marker key. Detection cannot see it, but this shape is not a blind spot the way a bare HEC event is: the capitalised keys are unmistakable to a human, and the mode is a receiver CONFIG choice, so an operator running HyperDx mode knows it and can say so with the envelope override.
